x-changelog.summary: Added async support to Manual Forecast Line Items endpoints
x-changelog.description:
The Create, Update, and Delete Manual Forecast Line Item endpoints now accept an optional `async` boolean parameter.
When `async: true` and Budget Columns 2.0 is enabled, the response is `202 Accepted` with a `receipt_id`.
When `async: false` (default) or Budget Columns 2.0 is disabled, the
standard synchronous response is returned. When `async: true` but Budget Columns 2.0 is not enabled,
the response is `422 Unprocessable Entity`.
